selection_approach_display: Manchester first applies the academic and SJT gates, then ranks eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total.

course.name: MBChB Medicine
course.notes: Five-year standard undergraduate A106 course. Applicants presenting a prior degree may use the evidenced A106 academic eligibility branch. A101 Graduate Entry remains reference-only and non-executable for A106. Applications are through UCAS with a 15 October 2026 deadline.

medical_school.name: Manchester Medical School
medical_school.notes: Production rules in this internal A100 portfolio profile are derived only from data/research/manchester-a100-research.json. Official evidence retains Manchester's A106 course terminology.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: ranking_model: ucat_ranking | ranking_factors: total UCAT cognitive score; SJT Band 1 preferred over Band 2 as the second pre-interview tie-break
applicant_pools.notes: The 401 Home places are course-level capacity and must not be treated as reserved solely for this pool.

applicant_pools.name: A106 Home contextual/WP interview-selection pool
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: ranking_model: ucat_ranking | ranking_factors: total UCAT cognitive score; SJT Band 1 preferred over Band 2 as the second pre-interview tie-break
applicant_pools.notes: MAP completers meeting all minimums receive a guaranteed interview. No fixed contextual places quota is inferred.

applicant_pools.name: A106 International interview-selection pool

applicant_pools.notes: International applicants compete only within their own cohort. The independently determined threshold is set after UCAT results are available; historical guidance is not a fixed cut-off.

applicant_pools.name: Graduate applicants to five-year A106
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Applicant cohort descriptor; selection remains governed by the canonical ranking_pools and stage_2_interview_selection sections.

overall_policy.description: Applicants must meet the minimum requirements for one supported academic route, take UCAT in the application cycle, achieve SJT Band 1 or 2 and satisfy the applicable application and professional requirements. Only the qualification routes represented below are executable.
not_eligible_if: The applicable published academic minimum requirements are not met.
UCAT is not taken in the application cycle.
The applicant receives SJT Band 3 or Band 4.
The applicant seeks transfer into A106 from another medical or dental programme.
The applicant was rejected by Manchester in each of the two immediately preceding consecutive application years.
overall_policy.notes: Unsupported or ambiguous qualification equivalence must return manual review rather than eligible.

requirements: The applicable standard or contextual minimum count at grade 7/A.
Two sciences or Combined/Double Science at grade 7/A.

accepted_equivalencies: Combined or Double Science as the published science alternative
gcse.notes: GCSEs are not competitively scored after the eligibility screen. Non-standard equivalencies not represented above require manual review.

grade_requirements.notes: The published subject-combination gate also applies.
The published subject-combination gate also applies.

contextual_offer.notes: Available only after Manchester verifies contextual/WP status.

subject_combination_rule.notes: The engine must select three full A levels that meet the applicable grade profile, then enforce Biology/Human Biology OR Chemistry as the first condition and a distinct approved second subject. Biology with Human Biology and Mathematics with Further Mathematics cannot be counted together. Extra A levels are excluded from the offer; there is no third-subject preference, and three sciences are acceptable.

a_level.third_subject_rules: No preference for the third full A level once the first and second subject conditions are met. Three sciences are acceptable.
a_level.notes: Offers are based on three full A levels only. Extra A levels are not included. Practical endorsements must be passed for every applicable science A level taken.

grade_requirements.notes: The supplied evidence establishes 36 points with 666 at Higher Level as the minimum.

ib.notes: Do not convert the competitive 37/766 profile into a minimum eligibility gate.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Chemistry and Biology are recommended Advanced Higher subjects, not encoded as compulsory subjects.

grade_requirements.notes: Both published grade profiles must be evaluated for this route.

scottish.notes: Chemistry and Biology at Advanced Higher are recommendations only. They must not be turned into automatic rejection rules.

btec.notes: No executable BTEC rule was supplied.

access_to_he.notes: No executable Access to HE rule was supplied.

degree.degree_subject_scope: relevant life or health science subject
degree.notes: The complete list of relevant degrees and equivalence decisions is unpublished in the supplied evidence. An unclassified or ambiguous degree subject must return manual review. A101 thresholds and places are never used.

post_16.notes: Published A-level, IB and Scottish rules are executable when the consumer enforces every applicable gate. The A106 prior-degree qualification route additionally requires confirmed degree-subject relevance. Other qualification routes remain unsupported.

ucat.validity_window: Only the application cycle in which the test is taken.
ucat.notes: A current-cycle fixed UCAT cutoff is not published. Historical values are guidance only.

sjt.pre_interview_tie_break: Band 1 is preferred over Band 2 after total UCAT score.
sjt.notes: SJT Bands 3 and 4 are automatic rejection. SJT is not part of the normal post-interview score.

conditions: Each A-level subject may be resat no more than once.
resits.notes: No broader resit rule should be inferred beyond the supplied A-level evidence.

english_language.notes: The GCSE/IGCSE English Language minimum is implemented above. No separate executable English-test equivalence was supplied.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: DBS, occupational-health and vaccination conditions apply after an offer.

ordered_process: Confirm the applicable academic eligibility route.
Reject SJT Band 3 or 4; only Band 1 or 2 progresses.
Guarantee an interview to a Manchester Access Programme completer who meets all minimum criteria.
Separate applicants into Home, Widening Participation, International and Graduate (A101) cohorts.
For other supported applicants, apply the independently determined applicant-cohort UCAT boundary.
Rank by highest cognitive UCAT total first; if equal, prefer SJT Band 1 over Band 2 and invite until interview capacity is filled.

ranking_factors.notes: The UCAT cognitive total is the primary interview-ranking factor after eligibility and SJT screening.
After total UCAT, Band 1 is preferred over Band 2. Bands 3 and 4 have already failed the gate.

score_components.notes: The live group boundary is cohort-dependent and unknown. Historical guidance bands are descriptive, not executable cutoffs.

total_score.notes: GCSE and post-16 academics are eligibility gates, not competitive score components.

calculation.notes: The engine can show historical guidance for Home standard, Home contextual/WP and International groups, but it cannot reproduce a live cohort ranking boundary.

ordered_process: Reject SJT Band 3 or Band 4; only Band 1 or Band 2 continues.
Place the applicant in the separate International cohort.
Apply the independently determined International UCAT threshold.
Rank by highest cognitive UCAT total first.
If cognitive totals are equal, prefer SJT Band 1 over Band 2.
Invite until International interview capacity is filled.
international_selection.notes: Historical International guidance is descriptive only and is not the independently determined live threshold.

thresholds.notes: No fixed 2027 cutoff is encoded. The separate historical guidance band does not determine eligibility or guarantee an interview.
A historically lower contextual/WP boundary is evidenced, but the 2027 boundary is unknown. The MAP guaranteed-interview rule is applied separately.

The International threshold is independently determined each cycle after UCAT results are available. No fixed threshold is encoded; historical guidance does not determine eligibility or guarantee interview.
Do not substitute A101 data. Interview prediction for A106 applicants presenting a prior degree remains unsupported until any distinct UCAT treatment is established.

selection_adjustments.notes: This changes the applicable pool; it does not add points to UCAT.
The guarantee never overrides academic, UCAT-presence or SJT minimum requirements.

tie_breakers.notes: Pre-interview tie order. FOI identifier and URL were not supplied.

historical_guidance_bands.method: Compare the applicant's current /2700 cognitive total with the minimum and maximum of the five supplied group-specific historical minimum-invited equivalents. Scores above the observed range are labelled strong historical position, scores within it reasonable historical position, and scores below it risky historical position.

override_rules: An ineligible academic profile is not rescued by a guidance band.

engine_notes.eligibility_scope: Automatic only for complete GCSE/IGCSE plus standard or contextual A-level, Scottish, IB, or already-confirmed relevant life/health-science prior-degree profiles applying to A106. Unsupported or ambiguous routes return manual review.
